VeraGrid.Gui.SystemScaler.system_scaler.interpolate_time_series_scaling(time_profile: DatetimeIndex, checkpoints: Sequence[SystemScalingCheckpoint]) → ndarray[source]

Interpolate cumulative load/generation scaling factors over a time profile.

The returned array has shape (time, group, 2), where the last dimension is load factor and generation factor. Declared checkpoint values are incremental over the previous declared factor. Values outside the checkpoint span use the closest cumulative checkpoint value.

Parameters:

  • time_profile – Grid time profile.

  • checkpoints – Scaling checkpoints to interpolate.

Returns:

Interpolated scaling factors.
